verification_evidence.fact: Spending is gross drug cost and excludes manufacturer rebates and other price concessions

access_note: data.cms.gov/data-api and data.cms.gov/sites/default/files return HTTP 403 (Akamai edge) to automated clients from every environment tested, including the deployment container, while data.cms.gov/provider-data and www.cms.gov return 200 from the same address. No API key exists for this dataset, so the 403 is not an authentication failure. File ingestion is the supported route; API connectivity is reported separately and re-checked on demand.

dataset.title: Medicare Part D Spending by Drug
dataset.coverage: Drugs prescribed to beneficiaries enrolled in Medicare Part D and generally self-administered.
dataset.spending_basis: Gross drug cost: total spending for the prescription claim including Medicare, plan and beneficiary payments. Excludes manufacturer rebates and other price concessions, which CMS is prohibited from disclosing. Not manufacturer net revenue.

verified_file.content_sha256_basis: SHA-256 of the CSV text as ingested (UTF-8, BOM stripped). This is the digest the ingestor computes and compares against.
verified_file.raw_file_sha256_basis: SHA-256 of the decompressed file exactly as downloaded, for a human checking the download with shasum(1). CMS serves it gzip-encoded.
verified_file.note: The contents of this file were read in full on 2026-09-29 to confirm the column names and values. A file whose digest differs is not an error — CMS reissues these — only a copy that was not the one verified by hand; columns are resolved from its own header regardless.

archive_retrieval.label: archived CMS publication
archive_retrieval.note: The Internet Archive's capture of the CMS publication URL. This is an archived copy of a CMS publication, NOT live access to data.cms.gov, and is labelled as such on every observation it produces.

dataset.metadata_source: HHS catalogue record for the CMS dataset (attribution: data.cms.gov)
dataset.published_on_basis: rowsUpdatedAt on the HHS catalogue record for the 2024 reporting-year release.
